prompt:
Deliverable: one chibi enemy battle sprite sheet, a single 16:9 landscape image holding exactly four separate full-body figures of the same creature, one image only. It is a game animation sheet; the reference images are numbered below the prompt.
SUBJECT: a Hollow Pilgrim, a pilgrim whose hours ran out on the road but whose feet did not: slow, stubborn and heavy, drawn in compact chibi proportion about 3 heads tall with a broad, hunched, triangular silhouette that is wide at the base and narrows to the hood. It wears a coarse woven ash-beige hooded robe (mid-tone #5F4D41, lit areas about a quarter lighter) with a ragged hem and layered folds; the deep hood is pulled forward so the face is only a pool of dark shadow with no visible features; a bulky worn matte brown-leather road pack with a rolled bedroll on top rides on its back; it holds one thick wooden walking staff, taller than its head, with a plain rough tip; heavy dark feet are planted wide beneath the hem. Matte cloth and leather only, with no armour, no bells and no chains. Use reference image 1 for the silhouette and material of this creature. The robe, pack and staff are identical in all four figures. It faces the left of the frame in every figure.
LAYOUT: four figures on one flat pure #00FF00 background, arranged in two columns and two rows. Imagine the canvas divided into four equal areas, each one half of the image width and one half of the image height, and place exactly one figure at the centre of each area. Reading order left to right, then top to bottom: top row 1 idle, 2 basic attack; bottom row 3 hit reaction, 4 defeat. All four figures are drawn at one identical scale, as four different poses of the same creature and not a turnaround: the standing idle figure is about 64% of the area height; the basic attack is the same height or within a tenth of it; the hit reaction is about 90% of it; the defeat figure is the smallest at about 55% of it. The lowest point of every figure (planted foot, knee or staff tip) rests on one shared horizontal baseline about 85% of the way down its area, with nothing hanging below it. Every figure, with its chains, bell, pack and staff, lies completely inside its own area and is separated from every neighbouring figure and from the image border by flat empty green at least as wide as twelve percent of one figure's width, so nothing touches or overlaps. Each prop stays physically attached to its figure. The sheet carries no grid lines, frames, numbers, captions, arrows, shadows or ground.
POSES, every figure facing the left of the frame in a three-quarter view: 1 idle: standing hunched and heavy with both feet planted, one hand gripping the staff planted upright beside it, the other arm hanging, the head bowed in the hood. 2 basic attack, Pilgrim's Weight: both hands gripping the staff, which is swung forward and down toward the left in a heavy diagonal arc with its upper end no higher than the top of the hood, the feet planted wide, the whole body leaning into the blow. 3 hit reaction: staggering back to the right, the body jerked upright, the staff slipping sideways in one hand, the hood still pulled forward over the shadowed face. 4 defeat: collapsed onto its knees with the hunched back sagging forward over the pack, the hood bowed to the ground, the staff lying on the ground with one end resting against its knee, the robe pooled around it.
STYLE: compact chibi game-sprite illustration in a dark gothic anime register, drawn with one uniform bold outline in deep ink (#120A18) about 2 to 3 percent of the figure height, closed shapes, flat two-tone cel shading with one small hard highlight per material, coarse woven cloth suggested by a few short hatching strokes; flat colour areas only, no gradients, no airbrush, no gloss, no realistic painted rendering.
LIGHT AND PALETTE: the same soft light from the upper left on every figure with no cast shadows; ash-beige cloth, matte brown leather and dark wood in restrained low saturation, darkest value #0F0D11, never pure black.
TECHNICAL: the background is flat pure #00FF00, one flat colour from edge to edge with no gradient, floor, vignette, shadow, glow, mist or particles; every figure has a crisp, hard, closed outline so it separates cleanly from the green; no green anywhere on the figures and no green rim light or reflection on cloth or metal; text-free.
Do not add: text, letters or numbers; grid lines or frames; ground shadows; a visible face or eyes under the hood; magic or impact effects; blood or gore; a floating or ghostly body; a chest bell or chains; modern items; extra fingers or limbs; a second creature.
